purpose: Experiment E-QTM-0068 in the quantum arena: a qubit traverses the entanglement wormhole perfectly (teleportation fidelity exactly one) only when the classical channel is used, and arrives maximally mixed (fidelity one half) without it, the traversable-wormhole picture where a coupling opens the throat.
